title: LISD Dedicates Conference Room to Former Board President Rafael Martinez
excerpt: Laredo ISD officially named the conference room at its Performing Arts Complex for former Board president Rafael A. Martinez in a dedication ceremony Friday, Nov. 20, unveiling his portrait before family, colleagues and community members.
content:
Laredo ISD has officially named the conference room at its Performing Arts Complex for former Board president Rafael A. Martinez, honoring his service to the district and its students, according to the Laredo Morning Times.

The dedication ceremony took place Friday, Nov. 20, at the LISD Performing Arts Complex on San Bernardo Avenue. Martinez spoke to a seated audience from a podium bearing the district logo, then took part in the unveiling of his framed portrait on stage as attendees applauded, according to the district.

The program included a JROTC color guard, the national anthem and pledges led by students from the Martinez family, and group photographs with his family, colleagues and community members.

The district said the naming recognizes the difference Martinez has made in the community, especially for LISD students, and thanked him for the time, dedication and effort he continues to give in support of students, schools and Laredo.

Sources: Laredo Morning Times, Nov. 25, 2026 — “LISD dedicates conference room to former school board president”, https://www.lmtonline.com/local/article/lisd-dedicates-conference-room-rafael-martinez-jr-22545882.php; Laredo ISD, Nov. 20–21, 2026
